summary: Each internal_tls consumer now declares its leaf in one importable task file — proxmox_host's extracted from main.yml, microk8s's carrying the eligibility gate and the install stat it reads (tasks/check-installed.yml) so the gate is right on both entry paths, openbao's already standalone. The two reloads carry their own blast-radius limit: Restart microk8s kubelite is a single throttle-1 task that restarts and then waits for this node's own kubelite endpoint (16443/livez on an apiserver node, kubelet healthz on a worker), and Reload openbao is throttle 1 so the Raft peers never SIGHUP together; throttle rather than serial, verified locally that it serializes strictly and that a failing host does not stop the others. Gate green (yamllint + ansible-lint).
